The Character Bible's five reference slots are empty on every studio that has ever run: POST /media/characters/{id}/reference-set fills them with real files but spends image credits, so it is the Owner's act and no stage of the day calls it; until he runs it, a character whose look is locked and has no readable reference refuses its film rather than having a face invented

No real render has gone through the second vendor or through the OpenAI /v1/images/edits reference path: a studio whose Owner has approved no alternative has a chain of one, which is every studio today, and OpenAIImageAdapter.REFERENCE_IMAGE_VERIFIED stays False until an Owner-approved run has actually drawn a scene that way

The Owner cannot answer an approval: a SUPERVISED day writes one owner_approval_request for the upload and stops there honestly, there is no route to approve or refuse it, nothing consumes an APPROVED row, no stage re-attempts after one appears, and the table is not yet in maintenance.HISTORY_TABLES

The daily job is seeded dormant and stays so until the Owner's recorded activation (workflow.job_activated); no daily run has been queued by anyone since Phase A, by the Owner's rule that video generation costs money and happens only when everything is proven

No real day has run with both channels bound: the per-channel publish policy, the serial's routing to OFFICE_SERIAL, publishAt and videos.update were exercised only against faked providers and transports
